modules.description: Workspace's own first-party package — provides the Processes, Steps, Composites, and Types that build_core() registers for this workspace.

modules.name: pbg-amici
modules.description: Process-bigraph wrapper for AMICI (CVODES-based ODE/DAE simulator). Real bridge to https://github.com/AMICI-dev/AMICI.

modules.description: Process-bigraph workspace: BIOMODELS regression — installs pbg-biomodels-bundle and drives investigations against the BioModels corpus

modules.description: Regression harness for BioModels: runs each model under multiple simulators (COPASI, Tellurium) and renders an interactive comparison report.

modules.description: Process-bigraph wrapper for BioReactorDesign (BiRD) bioreactor simulation

modules.name: pbg-caspule
modules.description: Process-bigraph wrapper for CASPULE (a LAMMPS variant with dynamic bond formation/breaking)

checks.name: open-mpi-4
checks.description: OpenMPI 4.x runtime — the lammps PyPI wheel was built against libmpi.12 (OpenMPI 4 ABI)

darwin.notes: Default open-mpi 5.x is ABI-incompatible with the lammps wheel; the @4 formula provides libmpi.12

checks.name: lammps-importable
checks.description: Validate that the lammps Python wheel can dlopen its native library
checks.notes: If this fails after open-mpi-4 is installed, the lammps wheel may need rebuilding from source: pip install --no-binary lammps lammps
